title: fix(app-shell): a page's Edit in studio opens the page in Studio, as the app bar pencil does (objectui#12540)
body:
Fixes #12540
Clause-②: no

## What

On a console `page` route, the page's own "Edit in studio" button now opens the page in Studio's Interfaces pillar, `/studio/PACKAGE/interfaces?surface=page:NAME`. That is where the app bar's pencil, the app switcher's Studio row and the sidebar's Design (objectui#12520) already go. Before this, `PageView`'s `openInStudio` built the metadata-admin path (`/apps/APP/metadata/page/NAME`) by hand, so the one handle labelled "Edit in studio" was the one that did not open Studio.

Direction A, as triage routed it (comment 6196397615): `openInStudio` goes through `appStudioRoutePath`, and the button hides when the app has no owning package, as the pencil does. ⛔ No fallback to metadata-admin.

## How

- `PageView` computes `appStudioRoutePath(activeApp, isAdmin && canAuthorMetadata, { type: 'page', name: pageName })`. These are the app bar's inputs on the same route: the same app document (the console mounts `activeApp` on both), the same authoring gate (`isWorkspaceAdmin && canAuthorMetadata`, objectui#10899) and the same route type and name.
- A `null` from that derivation is the whole predicate. It answers both "may this caller author metadata" and "does the app have an owning package Studio can open". No second copy of the owning-package lookup exists, and `appRoute.ts` is unchanged (dispatch assumption A1, measured: the predicate the pencil uses is `appStudioRoutePath` returning `null`, so no shared helper was needed).
- The authoring gate is kept and the package condition is added (A2). `reserveEditAffordance` on interface pages follows the button, as before.
- The file header comment that named `/apps/:app/metadata/page/:name` now names the Studio path.

**Recorded cost (accepted at triage):** for a page whose app has no owning package (a runtime or database-authored app, or the `sys_metadata` pseudo-package), the button that opened metadata-admin is gone.

## Pins

- New: `PageView.editInStudioOpensStudio-12540`.
  - (a) A click lands on `/studio/com.objectstack.cloud/interfaces?surface=page:welcome`, which equals `appStudioRoutePath` for the app bar's inputs.
  - (b) No button for an app with no `_packageId`, for the `sys_metadata` pseudo-package, or with no app resolved.
- `PageView.editInStudioNeedsAuthoring-10899`, updated deliberately, naming objectui#12540: it mounts the page under an owning-package app, so the file still pins only the authoring gate (c). Its four cases are unchanged.
- `AppHeader.pageRouteNoAuthoringHandles-12198`, updated deliberately, naming objectui#12540. The pencil's target is read from the navigate call its click makes. The page is mounted under the same app document the top bar resolves. CONTROL now asserts that all three handles share one target: the app bar button is `/studio/com.objectstack.cloud/interfaces?surface=page:welcome`, and the pencil equals it. The edit merged cleanly over #12552's edits to the same file.

**Ablation (pin (a), once).** The fix was committed first (`fe9d86953`). `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (objectstack) swapped `navigate(studioPath);` back to the old metadata-admin path. Anchor count went 1 to 0, and the blob went `2c4284106a11` to `7d2dd6e6f453`. Two tests went red, each with `Expected: "/studio/com.objectstack.cloud/interfaces?surface=page:welcome"` and `Received: "/apps/cloud_control/metadata/page/welcome"`:
- the new pin's lands-on test;
- the 12198 CONTROL test.

The result was `Tests 2 failed | 6 passed (8)`. The restore was proven by blob equal to HEAD (`2c4284106a11`) and an empty `git diff HEAD`. The subjects import `PageView` from source, so no `dist/` leg is involved.

## Verification (head `5bd928a76`, after merging `origin/main` at `5f8ecf678`)

- Closure build: `turbo run build --filter='@object-ui/app-shell^...'` ran under the verify lock. Result: 28/28 tasks, exit 0, at `fe9d86953`. Main's merged changes to `components` / `fields` / `plugin-detail` / `plugin-form` add exports only, and the post-merge type-check is green against that build.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check`: exit 0. Both legs ran (`tsc --noEmit` and `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`), and `--listFilesOnly` shows the three touched test files in the test leg.
- Targeted vitest, exit 0, `Test Files 30 passed (30)`, `Tests 317 passed (317)`. Files in the run:
  - every `PageView.*` and `AppHeader.*` test, and `appRoute.test.ts`;
  - the tests that read `PageView.tsx` source: `no-refresh-key-remount.ratchet`, `page-dom-leak-whitelist-7933`, `residue-namespaces-3546`, `page-key-read-census`, `vite-declared-lazy-views`.
- `eslint --no-inline-config` on the 4 changed source/test files: exit 0, 0 errors.
  - The 3 warnings are pre-existing `no-explicit-any` lines this diff does not touch.
  - Population: `eslint.config.js` `files: ['**/*.{ts,tsx}']`. File count 4, from `--format json`.
  - Invariance: the config declares no `parserOptions.project` / `projectService`. Type-aware linting is off, so this diff cannot move a verdict on an untouched file.
- Exit 0 on the pre-tsc battery:
  - `check:phantom-deps`, `check:self-import`, `check:unreferenced-sources`, `check:doc-example-readers`, `check:handler-key-reads`, `check:side-effects-array`;
  - `check:element-data-source-declaration`, `check:spec-symbols`, `check:action-forward-parity`, `check:designer-field-key-parity`, `check:icon-record-names`;
  - `check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-drift`, `check:i18n-designer-parity`, `check:control-bytes`, `check:new-line-citations`;
  - `scripts/check-hand-rolled-comment-mask.mjs`, `scripts/check-changeset-fixed.mjs`, `check-changeset-presence`, `check-changeset-no-major`.
- `check:spec-floors`: exit 1, `[no-artifact]` (needs a whole-workspace build). NOT MEASURED, recorded per dispatch.
- Full app-shell vitest project: NOT MEASURED. The verify lock was held by another seat's full `packages/app-shell/` run for more than 45 minutes, and the run was alive and busy, so it was not stuck. Type-check and the targeted set above ran outside the lock as a declared narrowing. CI runs the full suite.

## Acceptance notes

- Page names are compared as `useParams` decodes them. The app bar passes the raw path segment. For a page name that needs percent-encoding the two could differ; page names are snake_case identifiers, so this was not exercised.

- [x] Adds no product-specific widget, dialog, hook or string (see AGENTS.md › Product-neutral renderer)
